path.aria-label: Milo and Mia were playing on the kitchen floor, and Milo spotted a bottle under the tabel.
“Look, Mia!” Milo said with a big smile. “I found a secret bottle. I’m going to open it. Maybe it’s full of yummy candy!”
Mia felt a little bit worried and said, “I don't know, Milo. Maybe that's not a good idea.”

"Hi, I’m Patchy, your guardian" Patchy explained. "These bottles look like yummy juice or candy on the outside, but inside, they have 'yucky' medicine or cleaners that can make your tummy hurt very badly." WHOOSH! Suddenly, Patchy the Guardian appeared!

g.aria-label: “We must always ask a Safe Helper first, like a grown-up, before we touch a bottle.”

path.aria-label: “Okay, Patchy! We will ask a grown-up first!”
